notes.title: Release Date Set! 🎊
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hello Shopkeepers! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h3][b]We are excited to announce that Shopkeeper Simulator is launching on Steam this summer! ☀️[/b][/h3]

[h2][b]Open the doors to your shop on July 22, 2025! 🎊[/b][/h2]

[previewyoutube=iWmw2sX1Hmc;full][/previewyoutube]
Step into the shoes of a supermarket manager and build your retail empire from the ground up.  Whether you’re starting with a small shop or dreaming of a bustling supermarket, every decision you make will shape your success! 🏬

[h3][b]This is going to be the hottest release this summer! 🥵 Get ready now and add Shopkeeper Simulator to your Wishlist ✅ so you don't miss the premiere! 👇[/b][/h3]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1057580/Shopkeeper_Simulator/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34912963/765c71d14cff053de031a15b3854a1b3b2e39773.gif[/img][/url]

Join us on [b]July 22, 2025[/b] and experience the thrill of running your own supermarket! We can promise hours of addictive, rewarding gameplay in the full version of the game! 😎

[url=https://discord.gg/rYtWC5SV3Q][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34912963/c1f5a123a1c0cee520604fb90aff524e08896828.png[/img][/url]

See you at the grand opening!
Shopkeeper Simulator Team
